title: feat: add CatGPT comic prompt agent (registered, three verified comics)
author: Creatneworld
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #14822

Adds `apps/catgpt-comic/` — a Pollinations **prompt agent** (no code, no scaffolding, per the issue's "a prompt agent is fine" guidance). It answers any message with a short, sarcastic CatGPT line plus the matching single-panel comic, returned inline as a Markdown image.

**Live agent, already registered**

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Agent ID | `c35c537b-5bda-4919-bc30-b8b710674ad5` |
| Callable model | `community/Creatneworld/catgpt-comic` (alias `Creatneworld/catgpt-comic`) |
| Public repository | https://github.com/Creatneworld/catgpt-comic-agent |
| Type | `prompt_agent` · base model `anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5` · `mcpServers: ["pollinations"]` |

The agent is currently `private` — making managed agents public needs community publisher access, which I requested in #14870. Until that is granted the agent is callable with my own account; the three responses below are real output from it, and the raw JSON of each call is in the public repository.

**Three real comic responses** (live calls to `https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions`)

**1. "Why do boxes call to me?"** → *"They know."*

![CatGPT comic — Why do boxes call to me? / They know.](https://media.pollinations.ai/2cf1ff642ec3aa815fbf357c9786159f8bd645ded019d94428041ae262b16a2a)

**2. "What's the meaning of life?"** → *"Naps. Next question."*

![CatGPT comic — What's the meaning of life? / Naps. Next question.](https://media.pollinations.ai/2fe0a2d02b706d5b00f7d69120ffaaaf0bf98a7c32b2b346cb1db0a5c181a2c1)

**3. "How do I fix my code?"** → *"Knock it off the table."*

![CatGPT comic — How do I fix my code? / Knock it off the table.](https://media.pollinations.ai/59cbc57a1500ab015551179a3c0f05da0305f615842cf40cc96b2dac6f6b6557)

Every comic is rendered by the agent's own `generateImage` call and carries the `CATGPT` title box, the human's question, the cat's answer and the `@missfitcomics` signature.

Transcripts with the full raw responses: [1](https://github.com/Creatneworld/catgpt-comic-age

gist.headline: CatGPT Has Opinions
gist.blurb: A new prompt agent answers life’s questions the way a cat would: briefly, sarcastically, and with a custom single-panel comic. Ask about code, boxes, or existence at your own risk.
gist.summary: Added the registered `community/Creatneworld/catgpt-comic` prompt agent, powered by Claude Haiku 4.5 and Pollinations MCP, which turns any chat message into a sarcastic CatGPT reply plus an inline generated single-panel comic.
gist.impact: Developers can call `Creatneworld/catgpt-comic` through the chat API to receive a complete Markdown comic with the question, cat answer, CATGPT title box, and `@missfitcomics` signature.
